meta.name: Jacob Kirk
meta.summary: I like building things that have to work outside a demo: booking flows, payment paths, local dev tools, SSH automation, and network visualizers. I am drawn to the parts of software where reliability, privacy, and clear interfaces all matter.

about.body: I am a Computer Science major at the University of Central Florida. Most of my projects sit somewhere between product engineering and lower-level systems work: web apps with real users, tools that automate annoying setup, SSH/MCP experiments, and network diagnostics. I have completed Operating Systems and Parallel and Distributed Programming, and I am interested in work where authentication, payments, privacy, infrastructure, and maintainability are not afterthoughts.

projects.title: A-WELL Yoga
projects.description: Production Angular site for a yoga studio: content editing, class booking, capacity tracking, internal attendance tools, Supabase functions, and Stripe checkout.

projects.title: DisputeShield
projects.description: Browser-based chargeback packet builder. It generates PDF and ZIP evidence packets while keeping merchant files local instead of uploading them to an app server.

projects.title: Eustis MCP
projects.description: Unofficial MCP server for UCF's Eustis Linux server with SSH commands, SCP transfer, runtime diagnostics, and bridge mode for sandboxed clients.

projects.title: Devup
projects.description: CLI for local development setup. It detects dependencies, writes Docker Compose and env files, starts services, and checks health from one command.

projects.title: NetTrace
projects.description: TCP-first traceroute visualizer with streamed hops, geolocation, ASN/WHOIS enrichment, hop labels, exports, and a Leaflet map UI.

projects.title: Portfolio Website
projects.description: Static portfolio with project filters, a keyboard command palette, responsive layout, and a playable canvas Snake mini-game.
